change.description: Read and effect authorization now share the scoped intent, plan, live authority, provider profile, durable grant columns and dispatch-authorized timeline boundary while retaining their distinct permits and state transitions.

measurement.method: sealed PC01 _measure_sources implementation against committed HEAD

verification.initialInfrastructureCause: The first disposable DSN selected the absent legacy psycopg2 driver; the same live PostgreSQL container was reused with Eva's installed psycopg driver.
verification.initialRefactorCause: The shared UTC parser was called with an unsupported second label argument; all failures stopped during authorization before provider I/O.

nonClaims: The 75000-line release budget is not yet met.
Read and effect retain distinct intent-state, permit, event-data and corruption semantics.
This source consolidation does not itself deploy a new runtime image.
nextRequiredAction: Consolidate duplicated terminal provider-result and evidence validation without weakening replay, readback or corruption rejection.
